name: Persistent warp-specialized SM90 GEMM kernel
summary: Run a persistent Hopper GEMM kernel whose producer and consumer warps execute distinct mainloop roles and obtain output tiles from a hardware-aware scheduler.

strategy.intent: Reduce launch and scheduling overhead while maintaining an overlapped warp-specialized pipeline.
strategy.mechanism: Initialize producer and consumer pipeline roles once, repeatedly acquire work tiles, execute the collective mainloop, and commit results through the collective epilogue.
strategy.expected_benefit: Keeps Hopper SMs occupied across many output tiles and composes optimized mainloop and epilogue collectives.
tradeoffs: Persistent scheduling is sensitive to workload shape and cluster configuration.
Incorrect role or pipeline initialization can deadlock the kernel.

parameters.name: tile_scheduler
parameters.description: Policy that maps persistent CTAs to output work tiles.

constraints.rationale: The kernel composes both collectives through common problem and tile coordinates.
Producer and consumer pipeline parameters are initialized separately.
The kernel uses Hopper cluster and warp-specialization mechanisms.

references.evidence: The kernel composes mainloop, epilogue, scheduler, shared pipeline storage, and distinct producer/consumer pipeline roles.
